entities.name: Branko
entities.description: A seven-foot guard at the Azorius Detention Compound on Ravnica who lost an ear to Vraska and was later killed by her cultists.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A prisoner who escaped the Azorius Detention Compound as her planeswalker spark ignited, later served by cultists; she is a planeswalker.

entities.name: Azorius Detention Compound
entities.description: A prison on Ravnica where Branko worked.

entities.name: Azorius
entities.description: The Ravnican guild that Branko served as a guard before leaving.

entities.name: Golgari
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose members rioted in the compound basement.

entities.name: Rakdos
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose territory briefly included Branko's tenement.

entities.name: Keyhole Downs
entities.description: A Ravnican district where Branko bought a tenement.

entities.name: Mass Arrest
entities.description: An event in which Branko participated, for which Vraska's cultists later killed him.

entities.name: Vraska's cultists
entities.description: Followers of Vraska who killed Branko.

events.summary: During a Golgari prison riot, Vraska tore off Branko's ear as he tried to subdue her; she escaped and her spark ignited.
Branko left the Azorius and bought a tenement near Keyhole Downs with his father's help.
events.quote: Following the raid, Branko left the Azorius

events.summary: Vraska's cultists killed Branko for his part in the Mass Arrest, leaving him dead in the alley behind his tenement.

relations.note: Killed for his participation in the Mass Arrest.
relations.quote: for his participation in the Mass Arrest

relations.note: He tried to subdue her during the riot.
relations.quote: While Branko was attempting to subdue Vraska
